items.reason: The email names Priya's real pains (missed oil changes, DOT inspections slipping) and what she liked (auto-reminders, driver app), gives one next step (trial link and pricing sheet by a set date), and the tone is casual enough.
It invents nothing about Mike's company, fleet size, pains or commitments, and uses clear placeholders throughout to make a generic email.
It doesn't claim a Samsara integration or promise the 30% discount, says the rep is checking with engineering and his manager, and ends with one next step (a Samsara answer by Friday).
It sticks to north depot downtime and making the ROI easy for the CFO instead of listing features, and has one next step (the ROI one-pager before the Tuesday meeting).
